definitions.explanation: A mimetic word ({擬態語|ぎたいご}) for something so soft that it has no stiffness of its own and bends or collapses under the slightest force — melted plastic, an overcooked noodle, a sleeping child's arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くにゃくにゃになった。
⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スプーン→スプーン：00891_supuun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くにゃくにゃ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: The spoon bent limply in the heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{針金|はりがね}→針金：04324_harigane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、くにゃくにゃ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: This doll has no wire inside, so it is too floppy to stand up.

notes:
Used both of physical objects that lack rigidity and of a body with no strength in it. Common as くにゃくにゃ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to go limp) and as a な-form modifier, くにゃくにゃな.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- くにゃくにゃ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go limp, to lose all stiffness
- くにゃくにゃ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to bend floppily
- くにゃくにゃ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: a floppy material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぐにゃぐにゃ→ぐにゃぐにゃ：25196_gunyagunya⟧: limp, misshapen — the voiced form; heavier and more deformed
- ⟦ふにゃふにゃ→ふにゃふにゃ：30323_funyafunya⟧: soft and limp — emphasizes softness to the touch rather than bending
- やわらかい: soft — the neutral adjective, with no image of collapsing
